verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a payments platform with SDKs, dashboards and an MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes any telemetry or tracking controls or an opt-out mechanism. The docs cover payments, sandbox, notifications, PCI compliance and LLM-oriented docs, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
